description: This file contains benchmarks for the Orleans wire protocol's field header encoding and writing performance. It defines a class 'FieldHeaderBenchmarks' with methods to measure performance of different serialization scenarios using BenchmarkDotNet attributes.

classes.name: FieldHeaderBenchmarks
classes.description: Benchmark class for testing Orleans wire protocol field header performance.

methods.name: WritePlainExpectedEmbeddedId
methods.description: Benchmark for writing a field header with small field id suitable for embedded representation.

methods.name: WritePlainExpectedExtendedId
methods.description: Benchmark for writing a field header with a large field id delta, exceeding embedded size.

methods.name: WriteFastEmbedded
methods.description: Benchmark for fast writing of an embedded field header.

methods.name: WriteFastExtended
methods.description: Benchmark for fast writing of a non-embedded (extended) field header.

methods.name: CreateWriter
methods.description: Benchmark for creating a new writer instance.

methods.name: WriteByte
methods.description: Benchmark for writing a single byte to the buffer.
